title: I had a moment of weakness
paragraphs: “If you push, he’ll run away. If you really want him, you have to pull him in firmly! Got it!?”
“Gaelion-chan, you’re kind of… unique, aren’t you…”
“Please just think of it as the confidence of a winner. There’s no doubt that Gaelion likes Naofumi, so please don’t hate him.”
“I get it. So, Gaelion-chan, you might be drunk and not remember this… but I’m counting on you.”
“Don’t worry, I remember. Now that I’ve achieved my goal, I’ll make sure to carry out this next one properly.”
“Yeah… please. For Motoyasu’s sake, too.”
With a thud, Rival pressed his fist against his chest.

“Well, it’s a good thing that Lord Dragon, the god of Shieldfreeden, and the Shield Hero, the god of Siltvelt, are getting along so well. Still, from Siltvelt’s perspective, this situation looks like it’ll cause trouble down the road… Don’t you think the Shield Hero should be mindful of other things as well?”

While Father was having a friendly conversation with Rival right in front of me—who was in a daze—Panda offered this caution. Father glanced at the Shusaku representative standing nearby, then looked at Rival, who in turn looked at Panda.
“U-uh, yeah. The world situation has stabilized quite a bit, and we can even see the end of the Wave approaching… Um, about Lars-chan… Do you think I’m a bad choice?”
Panda sighed at Father’s words.
“Sigh… Are you really okay with me?”
“It’s the same with Elmelo and Eclair—you’re all so dependable, and I have a lot of fun being around you… um…”

“Yeah, yeah, I get it. I accepted this relationship from the start knowing all that was part of the deal. Since I got chosen as the Hammer Hero, even setting aside the ‘for the country’ part, you won’t get bored with me, and I might actually be a good match for you to settle down with.”
“I’ll go visit your room tonight,” Panda says. Even Rival is giving Father a nudge to go see Panda.
“Pandaaa! You’re late on everything! If that’s the case, you should’ve done it sooner!”
“Shut up! I really wish you’d stop calling me ‘Panda’ already!”
“Um…”
“Hmm? Elmelo, what were we talking about?”
“That topic was a bit too advanced for Kou-san.”
“Hmm… Unfortunately, due to the nature of my country, I can’t get involved…”
Hurriedly, Zou and Éclair tuned out the exchange between Fathers and sat down to eat.
“It’s a story that involves the troublesome politics of the nobility, isn’t it… Motoyasu-sama, Yuki is devoted solely to you!”
“Pfft… Sakura, I don’t really get it. Naofumi, what about Sakura?”
“Absolutely not!”
“It’s out of the question!”
Sakura-chan and Father, you say!? I absolutely won’t let that happen!
“Pfft.”
As Sakura-chan pouted and continued eating, I screamed from the bottom of my heart.
“You idiot, Father!”
I told her she mustn’t give her purity to a Rival, but she went and did it anyway! I’m done with her now! Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

…And so, life in this world went on in its own way. By the way, based on my and Rival’s advice, Father tried to obtain something similar to the Minute Hand of the Dragon Hourglass at the ruins of Filolial-sama, but he couldn’t do it. And so, just as before, we weathered the storms, broke through the final wave… and peace gradually returned to the world… It’s still unclear exactly how much time has passed.
Send Sakura-chan to her Finacée.
Give preferential treatment to the Tiger Girl.
Selective Retrospection / Random Retrospection ←
First Coordinate・Hard…………Reference…………Verification…………Retrograde Start――
This sharp pain piercing right through my skull! I remember now! Wait, this is actually the second time this has happened.
With a quick spin, I realized a new loop had begun and landed gracefully with a thud.
“Where am I…”
Judging by my gut feeling, I must have been kicked by Filo-tan when I first met her. Father, who had been grinning, seemed to click his tongue.
“Bubububu—”

The Crimson Swine is making a racket. He’s as ugly as ever. It’s a given that I’ll kill him again this time, but I’ll have to dispose of him a bit more discreetly. Ever since this new loop started, dealing with this guy has been taking up more of my time. Father even called me out on it a couple of loops ago.

When I looked in the direction of that unfamiliar voice… for some reason, it seems I’m in Riyute Village. That’s strange. If my memory serves me correctly, my fateful encounter with Filo-tan was supposed to have taken place on the grasslands.
“Where is this…?”

Filo-tan is here, along with Father and Big Sister, and the people of Riyute Village are looking at me with a bit of distaste. And for some reason, Crimson Swine is here with soldiers. It’ll be tough to take him out here.

And… for some reason, a dragon seemed to be locking eyes with Filo-tan, but now it’s furrowing its brow at me. I get the vague feeling there might be a Rival lurking here. This is the first time I’ve seen a scene like this. It’s a loop I have absolutely no memory of.
“What on earth is going on here?”
“What are you talking about, you?”
I’ve got to figure out the situation here as best I can.
“T-the shock of being kicked has me all confused…”
“Bububuuu! Bubuhi bubu!”

That Crimson Swine is squealing and making a racket, but I have no idea what it means. However, if I keep calling Father “Father,” there’s a high chance he’ll get suspicious. So, I’ll just call him by his first name. On top of that, the best thing to do here is to ask him directly.
“Naofumi, tell me… what happened.”
“No way. Just go ahead and lose your memory.”
Ugh… Father is being way too harsh on me. I suppose it’s only natural… but since there’s no helping it, I’ll ignore the Crimson Swine and ask the soldier instead.
“What’s going on here? Please tell me what happened. The impact of that kick made me lose my memory…”
The soldier looked at Crimson Swine with a puzzled expression before speaking.

“Just as the Spear Hero had received a fief from King Aultcray and was about to begin governing it alongside Lady Myne, a royal spy delivered a letter to Lady Myne. This led to a race between Filolial the Shield Hero and the dragon granted to the Spear Hero, with the village’s governance at stake, and Just as the Spear Hero approached Filolial, he was kicked.”
Hmm, hmm… I understand the situation now, but did something like that really happen? At least, there shouldn’t have been a loop like this.

But as far as I remember from the first world… ah, that Trash tried to give me a reward. At that point, I was more concerned about being scolded by Big Sister than about the territory, so I asked to buy a slave and set them free. While all that was going on, I remember the Crimson Swine talking to someone for a while, looking rather flustered. Perhaps there was a difference in the order of events or something like that?
Either way, Riyute Village should already have a ruler by now. I have no need for such a right.
But… just then, a scene from last time suddenly flashed through my mind—the one where Father gave his virginity to a Rival, and they were getting along so well.

Right in front of me was Filo-tan. There’s no doubt that in a few days, it’ll be Filo-tan. She’s already taken on Filo-tan’s form, rather than Sakura-chan’s. In other words, all the conditions are in place.
And in my pocket… I had the full reward money.
Looking back, I suppose this is exactly the kind of moment people refer to as “the devil getting the better of me.”
“I’ve just remembered something,”
Going along with the mood of the moment, I pretended to snap out of it—but suddenly feeling motivated, I approached Father, who was riding on top of Filo-tan.
“What? Just hop on already.”
“If you think about it calmly, don’t you think there’s no need for a race like this? If you want, I’ll just let you win.”
“Oink oink oink! Oink oink!”

The Crimson Swine is making a racket! Shut up! I bet the Crimson Swine was the one who started a pointless fight with Father and the others anyway. I can see right through that. So there’s absolutely no need for me to get involved.
“You’ve got a weird way of ending your sentences. What are you up to?”
“I’m offended you’d call it a scheme. Partly as an apology for that incident with—Raphtalia-chan the other day—I’m going to buy some Filolial from you as compensation for emotional distress.”
“We’ll see about that…”
“Gau gau gau!”
I get the feeling the dragon is making some kind of protesting noise here, but I’m ignoring it! I’ll toss all the money I have at Father.
“Who would sell to a guy like you—sold.”

Father opened the money bag I’d thrown at him… accepted it with a nod, and stepped down from Filo-tan. The “first-world” version of Father in my head says, “Well… at this point in time, it’s right on the edge of when you’d start getting attached to Filo, so if someone piled on the money, he’d probably hesitate.” The plan worked!
“Gwa!?”
“Eeeeeeeeeh!?”
Big Sister let out a cry of utter shock.
“Naofumi-sama, are you really going to sell Filo!?”
“—No, that’s not it. What are you up to!?”
Father snaps back to his senses and furrows his brow as he grills me.
“From now on, I intend to handle this with the utmost sincerity.”
He glances at the Crimson Swine and points to the letter in his hand. It’s probably a warning from the queen or something like that.
“Given what happened the other day, I’ve been thinking this was getting a bit strange. I think we need to sort out our relationship a bit more.”
“Oink! Oink-oink-oink! Oink!”

The Crimson Swine is squealing and wailing as if to prove a point, but I couldn’t care less. I can’t even tell if it’s throwing a hysterical fit out of sheer embarrassment or just making excuses. Well, I don’t really want to know, either. Pfft! Crimson Swine, just die.
“There you go, take him to the castle.”

It seems the soldiers are following my orders and taking the squealing Crimson Swine to the castle. It’d be fine if they just shipped it straight to King Faubrey… Well, I’ll just kill it secretly later.
Father is watching me and the Crimson Swine, looking deep in thought.
“You… really didn’t know… did you?”
“I’ve started to think something’s off, to be honest. As a token of my apology, I’d like to buy some Filolial from you. Would that be all right?”
Father fell deep into thought. After a while, he finally spoke.
“…All right then. It’s better than having you bow your head awkwardly—this way, I can spend my money with a clear conscience.”
“Gua!? Guaaaaaa!”
“Gau! Gau gau gau!”
“Ugh! Dragons are so noisy!”
I rub up against Filo-tan as much as I possibly can!
“Gwaaaaaaa!? Gwa-gwa!”
Filo-tan keeps kicking me away over and over, but that’s my reward! Thank you very much!
“The deal is done, then!”
“Yeah.”
“Eeeeeeh… Naofumi-sama, are you really going to sell him?”

“Well, yeah. It seems Motoyasu really does want to apologize. If he were just handing me money for free, I wouldn’t believe him, but this is a business deal. Plus, with this many people here, they’re buying from me while making him look like a fool. Lies won’t fly.”
“I hope so… But what about Filo?”

“When I first raised her, I knew selling her was a possibility, didn’t I? It does weigh on my conscience, but we don’t have time to waste. If there’s someone willing to pay a high price, selling her is just business.”
“Guaaaaah! Guaaaah!?”
Filo-tan is screaming her head off. It does make me feel a little guilty, but this is all Father’s fault from last time! I don’t want anything to do with a Father who gave his virginity to a Rival!
“If it bothers you that much, you can just go buy a new egg from the slave dealer later.”
“But…”
I think this kind of pragmatic attitude is very much like Father. And so, he officially transferred Filo-tan to me. I’ve been registered as her master in Filo-tan’s monster mark.

Foooooo! I’ve finally become Filo-tan’s owner, just as I’ve always wanted! 
Father turned his back on me, tilting his head at my response, and walked away, jingling his money pouch as he went. Big Sister followed him, glancing back worriedly at Filo-tan several times.
“Guaaaaaaa! Guaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!”
Filo-tan, held tightly in my arms, kept squealing repeatedly at Father and Big Sister.
“I did it! Father gave me Filo-tan!”
All that’s left is to secretly wipe the Crimson Swine off the face of the earth and kill Takt after making him suffer horribly! A new era of rosy days has begun! My life is looking sooo bright!
“Guaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
Filo-tan! I’ve got her, wooooohoooooo!

And so… I was feeling elated, picturing the days ahead with Filo-tan. To cut a long story short… I was greatly helped by Father from the previous loop, and while I truly came to understand his kindness, I also ended up suffering a deep, long-lasting emotional wound in this loop.

Random Retrospection←

“That was something I shouldn’t have done… That was something I shouldn’t have done… That was something I shouldn’t have done…”
That was something I shouldn’t have done…
Ugh… Father! Filo-tan—Aaaaaaaaaaah! Uuuuuuuuuh……
Suddenly, I realized I’d looped again. But right now, I don’t have time to worry about that.
Ugh…… Filo-tan, you’re terrifying…… Ugh…… What am I supposed to do? The thought that Filo-tan might show up again terrifies me! Aaaaaaaah!? Uuuu…
Shaking uncontrollably, I scanned my surroundings. I just can’t calm down! Where could Filo-tan be!?
No… where am I, anyway?
At first glance, it looks like Melromarc Castle. Why am I in a place like this?
I can tell from the hourglass icon in my field of vision that a wave is coming within a few days… Seeking nature and healing… I made my way to the Filolial House in the castle.
“Oh, it’s the Spear Hero! The chick is growing well!”
As I entered the Filolial House, the soldier in charge called out to me. Chicks…? Which loop am I in, and what was I doing here?
But upon hearing “chicks,” I nodded… no, with a strange sense of certainty… and headed toward that nostalgic place in my memories.
“Piyo!”
“O… oooooooooo… oooooooohhhhhhh… uuuuuuuuuuuuuu…”
And there, before me… I couldn’t help but let out a sob and shed tears. And no wonder. Because… because!
“Fure… On…-chan”

There stood Filolial-sama, in the form of an adorable chick. Her feathers were a vivid red, like flames. And her eyes, the same color as her feathers, were as beautiful as jewels. Begging me energetically for food… my very first encounter with Filolial-sama… Before I knew it, I was hugging Fleon-chan.
“Piyo~~!”
Hugging Fleon-chan helped me regain my composure a little. Immediately afterward, I gasped in horror as the realization of what was about to happen drained the blood from my face.
That’s right. If Fleon-chan continues to grow like this, she’ll meet a mysterious and tragic end.

Back when I knew nothing, I was saddened by Fleon-chan’s untimely death, but I didn’t delve deeply into the cause. However, based on what Father and Finacée told me when I brought this up, it’s clear that the Crimson Swine is the culprit.
First and foremost, I must protect Fleon-chan from Crimson Swine. To do that, I suppose I’ll have to… kill Crimson Swine. But killing Crimson Swine at the wrong moment could cause trouble.

I’ll make sure to confirm my ownership rights to Fleon-chan. Ugh… that Crimson Swine. I do, in fact, hold the ownership rights to Fleon-chan. What’s more, Fleon-chan has been marked with a High-Rank Monster Seal. It can’t be removed easily.

There’s also the commotion caused by the waves, and Crimson Swine is hard to get rid of… What should I do? From what I can vaguely recall, he’s probably resting right now in preparation for the next wave. For now, we should prioritize getting out of here. Otherwise, Fleon-chan will be killed tonight or tomorrow.
“Piyo!”
“Fleon-chan, we’re going for a walk.”
“Piyo!”
Perhaps she understood my words, because Fleon-chan is following right behind me. Heh… how heartwarming.
“I’m just going to take Fleon-chan for a walk.”
“Go ahead.”
After greeting the soldier in charge of the Filolial House, I head out into the garden.
“…Portal Spear.”

Gently, I enveloped Fleon-chan and used the portal to make an emergency escape from Melromarc. The first thing I need to do is lay the groundwork to ensure we can survive no matter what. So, even if it’s only for a short while, I’m going to thoroughly strengthen Fleon-chan.
“Let’s go, Fleon-chan! Hop up on my shoulder!”
“Piyo!”
Fleon-chan deftly fluttered up and perched on my shoulder. So, with Fleon-chan perched on my shoulder, I set off running with a dashing stride.
Fleon-chan, in this world, I’ll definitely protect you—! The Shieldfreeden arc is over. Starting next time, we’ll move on to the Legendary Filolial arc.
